description: RECSY v2 Golden Multi-Turn Conversational Recommendation (CRS) Trajectory Benchmark

trajectories.name: The Downward Budget Tightener
trajectories.description: User starts with $900 budget, tightens it to $550 on turn 2, then adds wireless charging while preserving the $550 cap.

turns.userMessage: Looking for a high-end camera phone under $900 with great zoom and night photography.
Actually my finances changed, I can only spend $550 max now. Still prioritize camera.
Make sure it supports fast charging and has great battery life too.

trajectories.name: Anti-Brand Pivot & Zero Leakage
trajectories.description: User searches for flagship, then explicitly excludes Apple and Samsung, testing immediate mutation latency and zero brand leakage.

turns.userMessage: I want the best all-around flagship phone under $1100 with a vibrant display and premium build.
I hate both Apple and Samsung, do not show me any iPhones or Galaxy phones.
I prefer Google Pixel or OnePlus if possible.

trajectories.name: Refinement vs Global Catalog Expansion
trajectories.description: Tests subset re-ranking over prior picks (refine=true) vs full-catalog expansion (refine=false).

turns.userMessage: Give me the top phones with massive battery life and endurance under $700.
Between these three picks, which one has the fastest charging speed?
Now search all phones in the store and show me compact ones under 6.3 inches.

trajectories.name: Clean Hard Reset & Ghost State Purge
trajectories.description: User sets strict iOS constraints, then executes a hard reset and switches to Android, verifying complete erasure of prior slots.

turns.userMessage: I only want an Apple iPhone with iOS under $1000 for Apple Watch compatibility.
Forget all that, start fresh. I want a cheap Android phone under $350 for my nephew with clean software.

trajectories.name: Clarification to Recommendation Policy
trajectories.description: Tests that high-entropy underspecified queries trigger clarification, and answered clarification triggers immediate recommendation.

turns.userMessage: I need to buy a new smartphone.
My budget is $600 and I play heavy games like Genshin Impact and need a high refresh rate display.

trajectories.name: Upward Budget Stretch
trajectories.description: User begins with tight budget, then stretches budget when seeking flagship cameras.

turns.userMessage: Budget phone under $300 for basic web browsing and social media.
Actually, I can stretch my budget up to $650 if it gives me a genuine flagship-grade camera system.

trajectories.name: Form Factor Shift: Compact Search
trajectories.description: User finds phones too bulky, introduces compact screen constraint under 6.3 inches.

turns.userMessage: Recommend a high performance phone under $800.
These are too big and heavy. I need a compact phone with screen under 6.3 inches for one-handed use.

trajectories.name: Form Factor Shift: Foldable Search
trajectories.description: User pivots to foldable devices, verifying foldable filter activation.

turns.userMessage: Looking for the ultimate multitasking and productivity device.
Must be a foldable phone with flexible screen.

trajectories.name: Priority Inversion Trade-Off
trajectories.description: User completely shifts primary axis from camera to battery and performance.

turns.userMessage: Camera quality is my absolute number one priority under $700.
Actually, change of mind: I don't take photos. Battery life and gaming performance are my main priorities now.

trajectories.name: Dealbreaker Keyword Defense
trajectories.description: User adds bloatware and slow charging as strict dealbreakers.

turns.userMessage: Looking for a clean daily driver under $500.
Dealbreakers: I absolutely refuse anything with bloatware or slow charging.

trajectories.name: Platform Switch Mid-Session
trajectories.description: User switches from Android to iPhone, verifying clean replacement of platform must-have.

turns.userMessage: Best Android phone under $800 with clean software.
Actually, my family wants me on FaceTime. Show me an iPhone under $800 instead.

trajectories.name: Feature Accumulation
trajectories.description: User steadily adds multiple hardware requirements across turns.

turns.userMessage: Phone under $600 with good battery life.
Also must have wireless charging.
And it must have NFC for contactless Google Pay payments.

trajectories.name: Liked Brand Conflict Resolution
trajectories.description: User changes preference on a specific brand from neutral/liked to disliked.

turns.userMessage: Looking for a phone under $750, maybe Samsung or Google.
Actually I changed my mind about Samsung, exclude Samsung completely. Only show Google or OnePlus.

trajectories.name: 5-Turn Extended Long Session
trajectories.description: Long 5-turn session verifying anti-forgetting and context longevity across deep dialogue.

turns.userMessage: Strict budget of $750 max.
I want the camera to be amazing for concert videos.
Screen should be compact, no huge phablets.
No Samsung phones please.
Clean software with fast updates is also a big plus.

trajectories.name: Zero-Match Negotiation & Recovery
trajectories.description: User sets near-impossible constraints, system handles gracefully, user relaxes budget, recommendations recover.

turns.userMessage: I want a titanium flagship with 10x optical zoom for under $200.
Okay, that's impossible. Let's be realistic: $900 budget, top telephoto zoom camera.
